description:
Search newly registered domains from the last 60 days by keyword, or browse a single TLD without a keyword. Filter by recency, registration term, length, character set, and sale status; returns the cross-TLD count for each name. New registrations are folded in continuously, typically 15 to 20 minutes after registration. Two coverage limits worth knowing: dates here are day-level, not clock times, and the 60-day history is gTLD-based, so country-code TLDs such as .ai and .io are present only for the last few days. When you need the exact registration time, the name split into words, or full country-code coverage, use nrds_live, which holds the last three days.

Related tools: nrds_live, whois, dns, ns_reverse, typosquat

has_sale.description: Filter to domains listed for sale

keyword.description: Search term (min 2 chars). Substring matching applies at every length, including 2-character terms.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match).

tld_count_max.description: Maximum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. See tld_count_min.

tld_count_min.description: Minimum cross-TLD registration count for the name. Integer 0-10000. Combine with tld_count_max for a range; set both equal for an exact count. Matches the prefix_tld_count field in results. Domains first seen only hours ago (live rows) carry a count of 1.

name: nrds

marketplace.description: Sale platform code where the domain is listed: se=Sedo, go=GoDaddy, at=Atom, vn=Venture, pd=PerfectDomain, gn=Gname. Present only when the domain is listed for sale.

prefix_tld_count.description: Number of TLDs the same prefix is registered under

price.description: Listing price with currency, e.g. 1500 USD. Only present for Atom/Sedo listings

error.description: Error message when success is false

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages

title: Newly Registered Domains Search
